proposal.name: Gate sampled Python applications and report actual results

plan.name: Gate sampled Python applications and report actual results
plan.summary: Complete #327 as one plumbing change: connect prepared Python application sessions, with explicit components or legacy inventory, to shared preflight, verify.Check, verify.Run, direct Python checking and CLI routing while preserving all applicable design gates and D-0183’s stateless handles and collector trust boundary. Check authenticated implementation observations against Init and Next with batched TLC at ratified bounds, require actual successful configured tests, retain independent failures and successes, and grant only sampled tested-against-the-model evidence with no proof, exhaustive-state, every-step or every-size claim. Produce validated independent component attribution and application receipts with actual invocation, tool, dependency, input, observation and outcome provenance, safe rendering, explicit gate-versus-supplied origins and complete portable deterministic fingerprints, preserving legacy receipts and rejecting unsupported modes before tools. Update SPEC.md with recorded decision citations and README with the complete manual-adoption layout, model, dependency/resource and read-back driver example, real human ratification workflow, verify command and coverage limits; factory drafting/synthesis and exhaustive/attempted-step checks remain outside this change. The new gate/receipt execution policy still needs a decision recorded by the merger using decision tooling; decision recording and unavailable Docker/network checks are Merger work, and the final head must pass INVARIANT_PYTHON_APPLICATION_GATE_REAL=1 go test ./internal/verify ./internal/conformance ./cmd/invariant -run ^TestPythonApplicationGate -count=1 -timeout 45m before moving on, while the same acceptance tests run meaningful non-skipping checks without Docker or TLC by default.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateAdmission
tests.says: Supported sampled applications, with or without components and with or without a Nagini marker, pass shared preflight; unsupported selections fail before tools, with no fallback.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateSessions
tests.says: Explicit and legacy prepared sessions use one staged application and one image; later original edits cannot affect execution, and omitted components never create inventory.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateResults
tests.says: The public gate and direct Python checker execute unchanged application calls; TLC checks authenticated initial/transition observations at the lock bounds; receipts record actual independent results and leave neighbors and proof unchecked.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateFailures
tests.says: Invalid model transitions, unbound or substituted lifecycles, failed/skipped/unexecuted tests, runtime/import errors and malformed/missing evidence fail while independent valid results survive.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateDesignObligations
tests.says: Pins, ratification, design, witness, fairness, temporal property and known-bug obligations still determine the gate verdict without erasing successful independent application evidence.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateFingerprints
tests.says: Repeated and relocated identical runs have identical fingerprints; each relevant input and actual observation changes the fingerprint even when outcomes and counts agree; original inputs stay unchanged.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateOriginsAndReceipts
tests.says: JSON and safe Markdown distinguish gate execution from supplied component evidence across independent transactional replacement, clearing and JSON round trips, without granting a supplied row a gate verdict.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateBatches
tests.says: More than 2000 actual distinct transitions use batched sampled TLC checks without losing run boundaries, bounds, counts or deterministic evidence.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateExactNumbers
tests.says: JSON integer observations preserve exact values beyond floating-point precision through TLC encoding; fractions and unsupported values fail explicitly.

tests.name: TestPythonApplicationGateCLI
tests.says: The CLI admits sampled applications before tool setup, rejects unsupported forms before tools, and the opt-in real command produces correct receipt files and exit status without Nagini.

usage.summary: Wrote `plan.json` for one plumbing PR, preserving the four drafted issues’ requirements. The check passed: all 10 acceptance tests fail on the base code, with real Docker/Python/TLC checks gated for merger validation.
